items.title: Cardinal Health (CAH) Is Facing Multiple Class I Medical Kit Recalls
items.summary: Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) is facing multiple ongoing Class I recalls of Presource PBDS kits that contain BD Alaris Pump Infusion Sets due to reported performance issues. The affected recalls, classified by regulators as the most serious tier, cover thousands of procedure kits used in hospital settings.
